title: Your rented homes, on the map
summary: A dedicated map layer shows rented homes with their addresses and daily rent, alongside your businesses and owned properties.

title: A clearer view of the city
summary: The redesigned map adds layer toggles, a floating places list, location cards and a full-screen view. Search and explore with smoother camera movement.

title: Explore your company on the map
summary: An interactive city map brings together businesses, purchased properties and searchable addresses. Location shortcuts open a map overlay without leaving your current page.

title: Factory lines get their names sooner
summary: Known recipe IDs now identify factory products immediately, so ingredient planning no longer needs delivery history. Manual naming remains available for unknown recipes.

title: Know when your previous save is loading
summary: A visible loading indicator explains when a remembered save is being restored. Clear recovery actions help when loading fails, and your previous page and selection return with your save.

title: Find saves on Windows and Mac
summary: Save help now shows a copyable path for your operating system, with a manual selector. Setup instructions are shorter and include native Steam saves on macOS.

title: More room for your dashboard
summary: The board uses the available screen width, crowded controls wrap, and repeated factory downtime sits in an expandable view. Remembered saves reopen automatically when folder access is still granted.

title: Turn supply plans into a checklist
summary: Supply Orders groups proposed quantities and estimated top-ups by location, with expandable checklists and copyable actions. Checkmarks stay in your browser as notes for changes to make in-game.

title: Better shared-ingredient planning
summary: Import planning now adds active contracts together and keeps orders needed by other product ranges. Hairdresser consumables and service fees are handled correctly in supply plans.

title: A lighter touch for the clock
summary: A subtle glow keeps the masthead clock readable as the balls roll behind it, replacing the darker background pane in both themes.

title: Smoother little interactions
summary: Masthead balls can roll behind the clock on narrower windows. Next moves cards have consistent spacing and respond promptly when you hover and tilt them.

title: Meet the redesigned Big Copilot
summary: A new look across the landing page and every dashboard view brings cleaner charts, clearer findings, detailed business cards and refined supply and growth tools, with light and dark themes.
